definitions.explanation: A prison sentence with no fixed end date, the most severe punishment in Japan short of the death penalty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無期懲役|むきちょうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{渡|わた}された→言い渡す：07002_iiwatasu⟧。
examples.english: The defendant was sentenced to life imprisonment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{検察|けんさつ}→検察：11086_kensatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無期懲役|むきちょうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{求刑|きゅうけい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{死刑|しけい}→死刑：13200_shikei⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{無期懲役|むきちょうえき}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{争点|そうてん}→争点：11468_souten⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a trial where the issue was whether the sentence would be death or life imprisonment.

notes:
Composed of {無期|むき} (indefinite, no fixed term) + ⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧ (imprisonment with hard labor). In Japan, {無期懲役|むきちょうえき} does not necessarily mean spending the rest of one's life in prison — parole is theoretically possible after serving at least 10 years, though in practice most serve 25-30 years or more before parole consideration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無期懲役|むきちょうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{渡|わた}す→言い渡す：07002_iiwatasu⟧: to hand down a life sentence
- {無期懲役|むきちょうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{求刑|きゅうけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to demand life imprisonment
- {無期懲役|むきちょうえき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧: a life imprisonment verdict
- {無期懲役|むきちょうえき}{囚|しゅう}: a life prisoner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有期懲役|ゆうきちょうえき}→有期懲役：29150_yuukichoueki⟧: fixed-term imprisonment — has a defined sentence length, contrasting with the indefinite nature of {無期懲役|むきちょうえき}
- ⟦{死刑|しけい}→死刑：13200_shikei⟧: death penalty — the only heavier sentence in the Japanese penal system
- {終身刑|しゅうしんけい}: life sentence without parole — does not exist in current Japanese law but is sometimes used when discussing foreign legal systems
